messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: surge in auth failures detected across us-east-1. Auth introspection/JWKS errors trending up at 2025-10-14 13:12:25 UTC.

alex: seeing spike in token-verifier metrics; console SSO failures and API 401s. Logs show 502/504 from Okta edge.

priya: support queue is filling. Some customers report "SSO looping back to login". High-touch accounts: AcmeCorp, BlueFin, NovaHealth. Tickets created: 89501, 89504, 89505.

marta: can you paste sample error? jwks or introspect?

alex: both. introspect returning 504 and jwks endpoints returning 502 in bursts. sample:

alex: ```bash
curl -i https://okta-prod-us.example.com/oauth2/v1/keys
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"bad_gateway","message":"upstream timeout"}
```

alex: token-verifier log:

alex: ```
2025-10-14T13:10:02Z token-verifier ERROR tenant=acme fetch_jwks failed code=504
2025-10-14T13:11:44Z token-verifier WARN using_stale_jwks tenant=acme age=27s
```

sam: impact estimate: ~10-18% of interactive console sessions fail for NA region; OAuth token checks for webhooks also seeing 401s leading to retries.

support-lead: drafting status: "Investigating — third-party identity provider degraded; some users may see login errors." Posting once SRE confirms.

marta: mitigation ideas:
- flip token-verifier to serve cached JWKS for short windows (ALLOW_STALE_JWKS)
- enable a per-tenant fallback to Auth0 for introspection
- add more aggressive client-side retries with jitter

alex: starting canary: set ALLOW_STALE_JWKS=true for token-verifier-canary in na-1, and bump readiness to 1 pod.

alex: ```bash
kubectl patch deploy token-verifier -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"token-verifier","env":[{"name":"ALLOW_STALE_JWKS","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
kubectl rollout status deploy/token-verifier -n prod
```

incident-bot: deploy event: token-verifier canary env change by alex at 2025-10-14 13:22:10 UTC.

marta: canary shows success rate jump from 84% -> 98% for targeted tenants. Promoting to 30% traffic now.

priya: escalated to P1 due to enterprise impact and SSO outage risk.

marta: paging SRE oncall: @pagerduty please ack. I'll take lead once alex hands off at 13:30 UTC.

pagerduty: acknowledged. Oncall rotation paged; alex acknowledged and marta scheduled next.

alex: also wiring a short-term proxy rule: for tenants with consecutive jwks failures, route introspect to auth-fallback cluster which is pointed at our Auth0 replica.

alex: envoy rule snippet:

alex: ```yaml
- name: auth-fallback-route
  match:
    headers:
      - name: x-tenant-id
        exact: "acme"
  route:
    cluster: auth-fallback
    timeout: 1500ms
```

marta: applied global feature flag to allow fallback routing. Observing token errors drop to ~3% across NA.

support-lead: posted status update: "Mitigations deployed (cached keys + fallback routing). We continue to monitor; some users may still experience issues."

priya: CSMs notified, manual outreach to top 5 impacted accounts in progress.

alex: Okta status page: "Intermittent errors affecting JWKS and introspection in us-east-1. Engineering investigating." Link: https://status.okta.com/incident/abcd

sam: follow-ups for postmortem:
- enhance JWKS resilience: dual-cache strategy, backoff randomization
- support per-tenant idp failover with clear SLAs
- add an alert for heavy reliance on stale JWKS
- run simulated idp outage in staging

marta: plan to leave ALLOW_STALE_JWKS=true for 90 minutes, then revert if upstream stable. Add ephemeral alert to avoid long-term stale serving.

alex: removing per-tenant proxy for acme now; routing back to primary as Okta PRs show restoration.

marta: monitoring: login success at 99.5% for 30m window; no JWKS 5xx in last 25m.

support-lead: closing tickets as customers confirm access restored. Notifying billing team about potential credits request.

marta: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 2025-10-14 14:45:00 UTC. Root cause: Okta returned intermittent 502/504 on JWKS and introspection endpoints in us-east-1. Mitigations: served stale JWKS and temporary Auth0 fallback routing per tenant.

marta: postmortem skeleton: /docs/incidents/2025-10-14-okta-jwks-introspect-region-us-east-1.md. Owners: marta (lead), alex (runtime), sam (post-incident), priya (customer comms).

alex: note: we should build a cached-jwks-only mode and allow customer opt-in for multi-idp failover.

priya: thanks team. I'll finalize customer comms and close the incident channel after ops tickets created. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident closed at 2025-10-14 14:45:00 UTC. Follow-up cards created in ops board.
